covered_report_window: After the U.S. market close on 2026-11-12 through before the U.S. market open on 2026-11-13
market_context_summary: PPI is due at 8:30 a.m. ET Friday; technology and AI shares remain volatile after a sharp early-November unwind, increasing factor and guidance sensitivity.

methodology.disparity_definition: 0-100 composite dispersion of the three direction and reversal-risk outputs; lower is tighter agreement
methodology.lessons_update: Raised expectation-bar and forward-look caution for premium AI-linked names; no broad method change.

ranked_companies.timing: Nov. 12 after close; 4:30 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: FY27 wafer-fab-equipment outlook and gross margin
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: China/export controls; supply constraints; elevated bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record operating momentum and a sharp pre-event de-risking favor upside if FY27 guidance validates AI, DRAM and advanced-packaging demand.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $4.06 EPS and $10.30B revenue; estimates rose while shares fell sharply.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FY27 outlook confirms strong DRAM, leading-edge logic and advanced-packaging demand with resilient margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: China restrictions, component shortages or weaker Q1/FY27 guidance overwhelm a headline beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 7.9%-10.7%; shares fell about 20% over one month, lowering but not eliminating the bar.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q4 EPS consensus rose about 9.9% over 90 days; analysts remain broadly constructive but supply concerns persist.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Fast growth is intact, but worsening Brazilian consumer delinquencies and a small negative estimate revision make credit costs the likely reaction driver.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.22 EPS and $5.70B revenue, with EPS revised slightly lower over 30 days.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Customer activity and loan growth beat while delinquencies and funding costs remain contained.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Provisioning and delinquency trends weaken risk-adjusted margins despite strong revenue growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 7%; a prior sharp selloff lowers the bar and raises relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Quarter EPS was revised slightly down; expected EPS/revenue growth remains about 29%/37%.

ranked_companies.timing: Results after Nov. 12 close; Q&A Nov. 13
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Expected sales and EPS contraction, category volume pressure and integration/execution risk leave a cleaner downside setup than the headline defensive profile suggests.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Street expects roughly $0.15 EPS, with sales and EPS down year over year.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Pricing, Simple Mills mix and cost control stabilize branded-retail margin.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Fresh-bread volume weakness and acquisition/ERP costs pressure margins and guidance.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Limited reliable public event-options data; defensive positioning may mute magnitude.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Institutional previews are cautious; expected sales decline is roughly 3%-4% and EPS decline about 35%.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: MSMB TPV growth and credit quality
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Improving TPV and explicit 2026-27 profit guidance support upside, but churn and credit normalization keep reversal risk just above allocation eligibility.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is roughly $0.49; investors are focused on TPV reacceleration and credit economics.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: TPV, deposits and credit income track or beat guidance with stable losses.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Merchant churn or weaker credit performance undercuts EPS progress.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 11%, setting a demanding hurdle.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public revision detail is limited; company guidance calls for 2026 adjusted gross profit of R$6.6-R$7.0B and EPS of R$10.8-R$11.4.

ranked_companies.timing: Nov. 12 after close; 4:30 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: AI orders, gross margin and FY27 guidance
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI order momentum is real, but the market already demands broadening orders and resilient gross margin, leaving limited room for a merely in-line beat.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.32 EPS and $18.1B revenue, essentially at management's Q1 range.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AI orders broaden beyond hyperscalers and FY27 revenue/EPS guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: AI mix compresses gross margin or management only reiterates a high bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 8.8%-9.6%; shares are down about 14% in one month but up strongly year over year.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Morgan Stanley downgraded to Equal Weight, citing strong expectations and AI gross-margin pressure.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Emerging-market TPV growth offers upside, but take-rate, country-mix and FX uncertainty prevent a reliable directional edge against a large implied move.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $0.21; the market is focused on TPV, gross profit and operating-profit guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: TPV growth converts cleanly into gross profit and operating leverage.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Mix and FX dilute take rate or guidance despite volume growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 12.5%, versus a larger long-run average actual move.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Reliable current public revision data was unavailable.

ranked_companies.timing: Nov. 13 before open; 8:30 a.m. ET call
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong prior-quarter comparable sales create relief potential, but leverage and strategic-alternative uncertainty dominate the earnings signal.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly -$0.14 EPS on $117.3M revenue after Q2 systemwide comparable sales rose 10.3%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Comparable sales stay positive and management clarifies liquidity/refinancing options.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Traffic fades or financing/strategic-review language raises solvency concerns.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Thin/small-cap positioning and low price can create outsized moves; reliable implied move unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Sparse coverage and limited reliable revision data.
